name: Colossus Trail
introDiscord:
A trail crosses the back of a Leviathan skeleton so enormous that early
travelers apparently mistook it for a road.

Colossus Remoras still cling to the ancient remains.
introTwitch:
A trail crosses the back of a Leviathan skeleton so enormous that early
travelers apparently mistook it for a road.

Colossus Remoras still cling to the ancient remains.

colossus-trail-approach.prompt: Three routes cross an immense buried scale.

left.message:
Shizuki's camp sits in a shallow groove:

'I walked on this for an hour before realizing it was one scale.

Taking emotional break.'

right.message: A Colossus Remora peels away from the scale.

forward.message: A navigator's chest rests in a natural depression.

colossus-trail-depths.prompt: The Pilgrim Trail continues along the Leviathan's body.

left.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's route marker:

'ROAD UPDATE:

Road is dead animal.

Still technically usable road.'

right.message: A wrecked strongbox rests beside an ancient travel marker.

forward.message: A Remora detaches from what you thought was a patch of dark stone.

colossus-trail-threshold.prompt: Three routes converge around Pilgrim Scale.

left.message: A Colossus Remora guards the oldest traveler markings.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle sits beside dozens of historic trail marks:

'People have walked this scale for centuries.

That feels either beautiful or extremely strange.

Both.'

forward.message: Star Candies lie beneath an old pilgrim cairn.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every Remora releases its grip.

One enormous shape remains attached to Pilgrim Scale.

Then the 'marking' begins moving.

Use /yes to approach Pilgrim Scale or /no to leave the oldest hitchhiker
in the Wake alone.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every Remora releases its grip.

One enormous shape remains attached to Pilgrim Scale.

Then the 'marking' begins moving.

Use !yes to approach Pilgrim Scale or !no to leave the oldest hitchhiker
in the Wake alone.
bossRetreatText: You step back along the ancient road-that-is-not-a-road.

boss.revealText:
A colossal Remora tears free.

Titanbound Remora reveals itself!

completionText:
The Titanbound returns to the scale.

The old pilgrim trail remains open.
